scope: Exact frozen qualification controller and data binding; successor of the retained CONTROLLER_SOURCE_HOLD. This is source acceptance only, not a new production review, runtime result, execution permission, C grant, queue admission, lease, release or merge readiness.

control_freeze.git_object_revalidation: Not performed; supplied staged-tree identifier is retained as freeze metadata. Every one of its 42 file hashes was independently matched against the supplied packet and checksum file.
control_freeze.no_new_commit_or_publication: As declared by the freeze; no Git or GitHub operation was performed in this review.

method: Static supplied-source reading, plain JSON data comparisons, SHA256 file verification and lexical byte comparisons only. No candidate Python import, AST evaluation, parser/helper/controller/oracle invocation, py_compile, Git fixture, Rust, build, test, formatter, native/provider workload, process-state probe, target/lock/cache/registry access, resource inquiry, inbox or meter action.

source_result.predecessor_finding: PRELOCK_GIT_CHECKS_PRECEDE_GUARDED_CONTEXT is corrected in this exact successor. No unsafe live configuration or historical unsafe execution is asserted.

routing_before_spawn.result: Every Git invocation passes through git(), which checks presence of the same ten GIT_ROUTING names as the maintained policy source before bounded_capture/Popen. Empty values still refuse. No variable value is logged, removed or replaced.

configuration_before_object_or_status.result: The first Git command is names-only NUL-delimited config enumeration with protective overlays already supplied. Conditional includes and partial/promisor config names refuse before index/object/status work. Sparse settings, when present, must parse false. Dormant filter driver definitions alone remain admitted.

index_and_attributes_before_status.result: Ordinary H index entries, nonempty unique paths, stage0, permitted regular/executable/symlink modes, exact 40-hex OIDs and exact HEAD mode/OID/path map are required; gitlinks/unresolved/hidden/staged divergence refuse. Both working and cached effective attributes are inspected before status, and every emitted filter attribute refuses regardless of textual value.
index_and_attributes_before_status.filename_argv_nul: NUL boundaries preserve embedded tabs/newlines; metadata headers partition only at the first tab. Path argv are separate Popen arguments after --, with at most 32768 encoded path bytes per batch and a per-path bound. Attribute triples must be complete, refer to a requested path and be unique by path/attribute. No shell, stdin pipe or new workload API was added.
index_and_attributes_before_status.fail_closed_limits: The inherited bounded_capture uses strict UTF-8 decoding and strip(). Non-UTF-8 metadata or leading-whitespace filename attribution can refuse an otherwise ordinary checkout; no filter gate bypass or false qualification follows. This is not arbitrary-filename support.
index_and_attributes_before_status.observation_limit: Configuration, index, attributes, status and source pins are discrete cooperative observations. They do not atomically exclude an outside mutator.

mechanical_conservation.main_delta: Exactly one guard_git_metadata(absolute_deadline) insertion at the start of nested source(); all other main bytes are exact.
mechanical_conservation.other_delta: GIT_ROUTING constant, relocated PLAN path and corresponding PLAN_SHA only.
mechanical_conservation.budget_custody: bounded_capture, immutable spawn tuples, separate original wait/evidence states, pidfd timeout handling, sticky supervision failures/cancellation, owned-descendant custody, phase invoke body, final double custody observation, C acquisition and original-Cfd-close/uncertain-retention bodies remain byte-exact. No LOCK_UN, unknown provider-descendant kill, new cold fallback, target creation or new cleanup policy was introduced.
mechanical_conservation.deadline: Each new Git operation uses the existing 10-second capture deadline and original wait/TERM3/KILL3 supervision. After acquisition it shares the existing phase and absolute remaining 2400-second cap. Pre-C metadata checks still precede that cap; they do not acquire C or run Cargo/tests.

binding_verification.source_binding_delta: Only packet path relocation from the predecessor binding; content claims otherwise byte-equivalent after path normalization. The current source-review archive entry intentionally has this new hash.
binding_verification.historical_archive_conservation: The other 27 predecessor archive leaves retain their hashes. Two new current archives are retained HOLD72b0 and maintained policy helperd0c. Author predecessor readiness/conservation/diff/README/checksum bytes remain separately named archival metadata; their old paths/hashes confer no current admission.
binding_verification.packet_mode: 0755, not the historical author's original0700 claim; dependencies0700, checked payloads0444 regular files. Current packet is not group/other writable.

preserved_future_plan.graphs: Separate --no-default-features host and ui invocations; no default/full/integrated or host+ui unification.
preserved_future_plan.sequence: HOST binary check -> HOST lib Cargo JSON compile -> actual ELF full inventory -> four assigned exact parents; then UI binary check -> UI lib Cargo JSON compile -> actual ELF full inventory -> twelve assigned exact parents.
preserved_future_plan.lane: Existing C target and lock unchanged, jobs2, physical Rust1.93 tool paths and SHA pins conserved; neither existence nor availability probed.

retained_limits.guard_oracles: Inert source-derived future oracle data only. No real Git fixture or new guard runtime result exists.
retained_limits.current_rust_runtime: HOST/UI check, compilation, actual ELF discovery and all sixteen assigned owning parents remain UNRUN. This source verdict records zero passes.
retained_limits.filtered_N_minus_1: parent_pass is byte-exact. It enforces exact run1/named-ok/1P0F0I event shape but only syntax-checks the filtered-out integer. A sole original raw owning-parent summary must be independently checked against that lane's fresh complete inventory N-1; no source count or runner qualified flag substitutes for this.
retained_limits.negative_path_ELF_hash: Digest is checked before inventory/each owning parent and after invoke returns successfully. A failed/timeout/uncertain invoke skips the post-use digest. No post-failed-use ELF hash or full archived ELF bytes are guaranteed. Preserve the original negative and make no failed-use immutability claim.
retained_limits.grant: The validator checks only verdict/head/tree/runner_sha256/plan_sha256. This actual review supplies those fields; it invents no independent authority mechanism. Grant text is correlation syntax, not freshness, once-only authorization or an actual grant. Root must separately coordinate any fresh real grant and scheduling.
retained_limits.custody: Positive handback still requires exact successful-spawn/original-wait/evidence correspondence and clean unforced phase plus both final custody observations. Timeout, unknown wait, forced cleanup, sticky supervision failure or ambiguous close cannot become qualification or safe-return evidence. Retained external-kill limitation remains.
retained_limits.source_context: No assertion of current ambient Git configuration, current target/tool state or live process custody was made.
retained_limits.historical_negatives: Old015e Script infrastructure failure,6327 FK source-oracle defect,clean-textual-merge duplicate source finding and predecessor4288 Git-guard HOLD remain separate from corrections; none becomes an executed runtime/compiler failure or retroactive pass.
retained_limits.script_success: Copied exact4fa Script contracts41084001631/job124160232059 SUCCESS receipt remains separate from the manifest's original RUNNING observation and historical failures. It establishes zero Cargo/test/native passes.
retained_limits.whitespace: Freeze reports six source-owned files diff-check PASS and whole staged diff-check EXIT2 on preserved historical/raw bytes. This review did not run diff-check and makes no whole staged whitespace PASS claim.
retained_limits.excluded_qualification: No native/provider/development-runner/daemon/desktop, broad all-targets, whole-inventory/WHOLE/SeedView/admission, installed-product, release or merge qualification.
